data.name: Avron
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew 'avar' meaning 'father' and 'ron' meaning 'bear'. Avron may be interpreted as the 'father of a bear' or 'bear-father'. In the Old Testament, Avram (Avron's Hebrew variant) is the name of a patriarch who is called Abram in the Old Testament and Abraham in the New Testament. He is considered the founder of the Jewish people.
